# Listening visuals

The listening-mode visualizer adapts the Canvas pill-bar and line rendering and smoothing techniques from **Audio Visualizer** by **aadixc0de / chatcn**, retrieved through 21st.dev. [Component source](https://21st.dev/@aadixc0de/components/audio-visualizer)

The visualizer uses the extension's native TypeScript and Canvas implementation with live audio analysis from the current video. The listening surface reuses MARGIN's existing page background renderer and settings.
